ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels comprising ~90% of the fluke surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and in sparse mottling clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel clusters are localized at the far-left and far-right lobe vertices; sparse, irregular white pixel mottling is detected across the lower-medial portion of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central notch with an approximate 2D pixel-measured interior angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of variations is most pronounced on the distal 30% of the right lobe with peaks of 5-10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical sigmoidal trajectory; concave curvature at the medial notch transitioning to a convex sweep toward the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast white pixel clusters on the extreme tips of both lobes; two distinct circular ring-like high-contrast marks visible on the upper surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical and diagonal white linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower-left lobe surface, breaking the dark pigmentation background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcareous-type high-contrast deposits/encrustations localized on the lateral margins of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent high-intensity white circular focal spot located in the upper-medial region of the left lobe.
